How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Start slow on the lowest setting, and use a little water-based lube around the area for comfort. With Pebble Pro, try the suction head first by placing it around—not pressing hard on—the most sensitive spot, then make tiny angle changes until it feels right; if it gets too intense, lower the setting or slightly break the seal. Clean the head with mild soap and water after use.
